text: Which North York Moors village played Aidensfield in ITV's Heartbeat?
info: Goathland, on the North York Moors; its station was also Hogsmeade in the Harry Potter films.

text: Which island in the Firth of Forth holds the world's biggest colony of northern gannets?
info: The Bass Rock, off North Berwick in East Lothian; it turns white with around 150,000 gannets.

text: Which Cornish fishing village plays Portwenn in Doc Martin?
info: Port Isaac, on Cornwall's north coast.

text: In which North Yorkshire market town did the real James Herriot, Alf Wight, have his vet's practice?
info: Thirsk; the old surgery at 23 Kirkgate is now The World of James Herriot.

text: Which Highland village on Loch Carron played Lochdubh in Hamish Macbeth?
info: Plockton, in Wester Ross, looking out to Skye.

text: Where on Hadrian's Wall did a famous tree, seen in Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves, get cut down overnight in 2023?
info: Sycamore Gap, between Housesteads and Steel Rigg; the tree was felled in September 2023.

text: Which seaside landmark did Dire Straits sing about in 'Tunnel of Love'?
info: The Spanish City, Whitley Bay, restored and reopened in 2018.

text: Which red-and-white striped lighthouse near Whitburn was the first in the world built to use alternating current?
info: Souter Lighthouse, on the cliffs at Marsden between South Shields and Whitburn; it opened in 1871.
